verses.1: I was taken away from there. I couldn’t find them anywhere. They said, “Here I am! Here I am!” But they didn’t call me by my name.
verses.2: I have stretched out my hands today to those who walk in evil ways, and who do not follow the right path. After all their thoughts…
verses.3: The people who are angry with me always praise the gardens and admire the tiles.
verses.4: Those who are buried in graves and tombs, they eat food that comes from the stomach of a pig, along with various kinds of rotten food.
verses.5: They say, “Let them come to you. Do not go against them, for you have been sanctified by these fragrant fumes in my mouth. Fire will burn them all today.”
verses.6: See, it is written before me: “I will not do it.” But I have done it, and I have fulfilled my duty.
verses.7: “You and your ancestors have sinned together. But the LORD says that those who have sinned on the mountains and in the valleys will be punished. Their deeds will be remembered forever.”
verses.8: So said Yahweh: “When the land is found in the burning fire, do not destroy it. For there is blessing in it. Thus shall I do for my servants; otherwise, I will destroy everything.”
verses.9: And I was born from Jacob’s seed; from Judah, he inherited the land. He inherited it by my choice, and my servants settled there.
verses.10: And it shall be a sign for the sheep, and a deep valley for those who come from the north to my people, who seek me.
verses.11: And you, children of Jehovah, who forget about my holy mountain, which is worthy of being treated with respect and reverence. You treat it like a mere storeroom or a place for storing goods.
verses.12: And I have chosen you to be destroyed, and all of you will be killed. You refused when I called to you, and you did not listen. I said what I said, but you did not hear. So, evil was done in my eyes, even though I did not want you to be destroyed.
verses.13: Therefore, thus says the Lord God: Look, my servants will eat, and you will be hungry. Look, my servants will drink, and you will be thirsty. Look, my servants will rejoice, and you will suffer.
verses.14: Look, my servants have done what is good in their hearts. But you will cry out in pain and sorrow.
verses.15: And your names were given to serve Me as chosen ones. But you shall die, O Adonai Yehovah, and your name will be called another name among His servants.
verses.16: Whoever is blessed in this land will be blessed in the Lord with truth. And whoever is praised in this land will be praised in the Lord with truth. For they have forgotten their former troubles, and they have been hidden from our eyes.
verses.17: For I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former ones will not be remembered, nor will they be brought to mind anymore.
verses.18: For if they are destroyed and their days are shortened, then I, who create all things, will surely bring about the destruction of Jerusalem and its people.
verses.19: And I cried out in Jerusalem, and I wailed among my people. But no one heard my cries or my screams anymore.
verses.20: No one shall live there anymore for many days and years. The man who is a hundred years old will die, and the boy who is a hundred years old will be considered old.
verses.21: And they built houses, and they lived in them. They planted trees, and they ate their fruits.
verses.22: They will not build, and someone else will sit in their place. They will not plant anything, and someone else will eat what they have grown. For the days of these trees are over for my people, and their actions will bring them destruction.
verses.23: They shall not touch the empty space, nor be born in despair. For the seed of Jehovah’s people and their descendants are with them.
verses.24: And before they call, I will still answer them. While they continue to speak, I will still listen.
verses.25: Zeb and Tala will harm each other together. The lion will eat the woodpecker in the morning. But the scorpion will not harm or destroy anything in all the holy mountains. As Jehovah said:
